'''Second Undersupervisor''' was a title held by [[Daye Azur-Jamin]] during his time as an employee of [[I'att Armament]] under which he stood to inherit the company with his lover and superior [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]] following the retirement of its founders.
